title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, administrator-driven workflow, mailbox prerequisites and storage permissions agree with Microsoft's notice and roadmap. The Azure controls, published bulk-import licensing rights and storage meters are supported; minor corrections concern uncited supporting sources and checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import documentation has file-size and archive-import limits; the briefing asks rather than asserts whether they apply to Azure PST Import.
claims.quote: Upload or copy PST files that are no larger than 20 GB. ... you can't import more than 100 GB of data into a user's archive in a single import.
